name: get_goal
description: Read the current Goal identity, objective, evidence cursor, and bounded evidence-reference catalog for this permitted Goal turn. Outside a permitted Goal turn it reports "active": false together with "lastGoal", a scalar summary (goalId, revision, status, turnCount, activeTimeMs, and lastReason when one was recorded) of the session's most recent Goal, so a Goal that has already stopped can still be inspected. It never returns uncited transcript history or changes Goal state. Use the result silently; do not narrate or acknowledge the retrieval to the user.
